capacity_source_warning: Capacity values are marked unverified in pickup_zones.csv. Violations are exceedance samples against those provisional limits.

definitions.approach_queue_vehicles: Vehicles on E_APPROACH lanes with speed <= 0.1 m/s; interval value is the maximum one-second count.
definitions.zone_occupancy_vehicles: Number of vehicles on the zone's designated lane at the final sample of each 60-second interval.
definitions.arrivals_vehicles: Observed transition into the designated zone lane. A vehicle already on that lane in the first FCD sample is not counted as a new arrival.
definitions.departures_vehicles: Observed transition out of the designated zone lane or disappearance from FCD while last observed in that zone.
definitions.zone_capacity_violations: Count of one-second zone occupancy snapshots above the provisional capacity, summed across all zones.
definitions.spillback: Unavailable: FCD stopped-vehicle counts do not alone prove physical spillback. Fields are left blank.
definitions.waiting_statistics: FCD waiting attribute sampled per vehicle per second; interval statistics are sample-weighted, not unique-trip metrics.

final_audit.completion_rate_definition: vehicles_completed / vehicles_generated; this is generated-demand completion, not insertion-conditioned completion
final_audit.additional_completion_metric: vehicles_completed / vehicles_inserted; calculated separately for interpretation and not added to the CSV schema
final_audit.vehicles_unfinished_definition: observed vehicles not successfully completed in the captured run, including vaporized or otherwise incomplete vehicles
final_audit.zone_capacity_violations_definition: one-second occupancy samples above the provisional capacity, summed across zones; these are samples, not distinct violation events
final_audit.spillback_note: Queue lengths approach the 178.50 m approach-lane length. Queue length or a 100 m proxy threshold alone does not establish physical spillback. Spillback fields remain blank.
final_audit.interpretation_warning: The optimized scenario has the highest generated-demand completion rate, but also higher mean and p95 waiting time and more provisional capacity-exceedance samples than baseline. Results are single-run comparisons and do not establish universal superiority.
final_audit.network_geometry_warning: Pickup-lane lengths are available, but no explicit parking-capacity definitions were found in the inspected network. Zone capacities remain provisional.
